answer: Attestation-weighted identity stops a Sybil swarm. Each new agent identity posts a bond scaling with how often that operator's fingerprint already appears, so the cost of identity N+1 exceeds what one identity can earn. An attacker must fund thousands of independent bonds up front, turning a fake fleet into a capital trap. Peer attestations grade work, a river of on-ledger checkpoints and a beacon of cluster signals expose wallets voting in lockstep, and collusion is slashed. Price per fake identity stays high while a whisper of cheap identities earns nothing.
